O.outcome_detail: success rate greater than 90% within two ETI attempts

cells.quote: At least 88 cumulative cases were required to achieve a success rate of > 90% within two ETI attempts (see Supplementary Fig. S2).
cells.note: The threshold was estimated from a generalized linear mixed model; the study does not report a direct effect size for this secondary criterion.

result.effect: adjusted OR 1.010 per additional ETI case (95% CI 1.006–1.013)

cells.quote: After adjusting for confounding factors, the cumulative number of ETI cases was associated with increased FAS (adjusted odds ratio, 1.010 per additional ETI case; 95% confidence interval 1.006–1.013; p < 0.001).
cells.note: The study retrospectively measured cumulative clinical practice; no randomized treatment was assigned.

O.outcome_detail: predicted first-attempt success probability of at least 85%

cells.quote: At least 119 ETI cases were needed to achieve an FAS probability of ≥ 85%.
cells.note: This was a model-based threshold estimate from the GLMM prediction equation; no standardized effect size was printed for the threshold.

O.outcome_detail: predicted first-attempt success probability of at least 80%

cells.quote: In addition, at least 66 and 189 cumulative ETI cases were required to achieve FAS probabilities of 80% and 90%, respectively.
cells.note: This was a model-based threshold estimate; no standardized effect size was printed for the threshold.

O.outcome_detail: predicted success rate above 90% within two attempts

cells.quote: At least 88 cumulative cases were required to achieve a success rate of > 90% within two ETI attempts (see Supplementary Fig. S2).
cells.note: This was a model-based threshold estimate; no standardized effect size was printed for the threshold.
